newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia plans drop weekly inflation data - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russia plans drop weekly inflation data - Tass.

text.p: Russia's State Statistics Committee plans to stop publishing weekly consumer price data next year because of the steep decline in inflation, Itar-Tass news agency said on Thursday.
It said the committee would continue to publish monthly figures.
The committee said earlier on Thursday that inflation in the week to December 16 slowed to 0.3 percent from 0.4 percent the previous week.
It said that if the current rate was maintained, inflation for the year would be 22 percent. Prices rose 131 percent year-on-year in December 1995.
